name: me
description: Human-centered skills: the goal is that the user understands more, not that the agent finishes a task. teach-me-this trains research ability by having the user work through 2–3 exercises on a published paper: they write a complete answer, it is scored against a fixed rubric, then the paper's answer is revealed and they analyze the gap.

interface.shortDescription: Skills that build your understanding, not just finish the task.
interface.longDescription: Me is a set of human-centered skills. teach-me-this takes a paper you have not read and hides it behind a private answer card. It turns the paper into 2–3 exercises: find the research problem from messy observations, design the solution, design the key experiments, or transfer the idea. For each one you write a complete answer, it is scored against a rubric fixed in advance, and only then is the paper's answer revealed, so you can analyze the gap. It ends with feedback per ability and a log that tracks weak spots across papers.
defaultPrompt: Use teach-me-this to train me with this paper
Teach me this paper without spoiling it
